en.headline: Reportable police complaints fall 5pc, but assault claims rise
en.dek: IPCC figures for the first eight months show 1,353 reportable complaints, while serious allegations rose 44 per cent to 95, including 90 of assault.
body: The Independent Police Complaints Council said on Tuesday that the Complaints Against Police Office recorded 1,353 reportable complaints in the first eight months of 2026, 5 per cent fewer than in the same period last year.

Those complaints involved 1,731 allegations, down 6 per cent. Neglect of duty accounted for 971 allegations and misconduct, impoliteness or foul language for 665. Together they made up about 95 per cent of all allegations, the council said at an open meeting.

Serious allegations rose 44 per cent year on year to 95. They included 90 allegations of assault, three of abuse of power, and one each of intimidation and fabrication of evidence. Assault allegations were up 67 per cent; 87 of the 90 arose from arrest operations.

IPCC chairperson Priscilla Wong Pui-sze said the council understood that police resources could not be expanded without limit, but that the standard of service should not be lowered. The figures record allegations referred for two-tier review; they are not findings that the complaints have been substantiated.

zh.headline: 首八個月須匯報投訴警隊個案跌5% 毀打指控升67%
zh.dek: 監警會公布1,353宗須匯報投訴，較去年同期少；性質嚴重指控95項，其中毀打90項，多數源自拘捕行動。
body: 獨立監察警方處理投訴委員會周二表示，投訴警察課在2026年首八個月接獲1,353宗須匯報投訴，較去年同期下跌5%。
相關投訴共涉及1,731項指控，按年跌6%。疏忽職守佔971項，行為不當、態度欠佳或粗言穢語佔665項，合計約佔全部指控95%。監警會在公開會議上公布有關數字。
性質嚴重的指控按年升44%至95項，包括毀打90項、濫用職權3項，以及恐嚎與捏造證據各1項。毀打指控按年升67%，當中87項源自拘捕行動。
監警會主席王沛詩表示，明白警方資源及人手不可能無限增加，但強調不應降低對警察服務質素的要求。上述數字為轉介兩層投訴制度審視的指控，並非已裁定屬實的結論。
